confidence_notes: Holistic general-knowledge estimates; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were consulted, and 2026 levels are projected forward from recent knowledge. Beer and restaurant anchors are the firmest. July peak-season hostel and hotel rates have the widest plausible range. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor for a plausible local price relationship because direct knowledge is only moderate. Euro-denominated estimates were converted to USD at an approximate general-knowledge rate, not a live quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: Amsterdam-specific general knowledge, placed within the general price level of other high-cost Western European capitals with strong summer hotel demand; no comparable-city price data was consulted.
